THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of land depicted in below names and extents in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2023/537 dated 27.10.2023 prepared by the Survey General situated in the village called Olaithoduvai in the Grama Niladhari Division No. MN/60, of Ollaithoduvai in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follow:

01. Lot zAZ - Olaithoduvaikaani - Extent : 0.0691 Hectare North: Olaithoduvaikaani (claimant not known); East : Olaithoduvaikaani (claimant not known); South: Lot B and Olaithoduvaikaani (claimant not known); West: Lot B and Olaithoduvaikaani (claimant not known).

02. Lot zBZ - Olaithoduvaikaani - Extent : 0.1486 Hectare North: Lot A and Olaithoduvaikaani (claimant not known); East : Olaithoduvaikaani (claimant not known) and Thoddaveli Grama Niladhari Division; South: Thoddaveli Grama Niladhari Division and Olaithoduvaikaani (claimant not known); West: Olaithoduvaikaani (claimant not known). Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref. No. : 4-3/11/2023/RE/177.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,''Mihikatha Medura", Rajamalwatta Avenue,Battaramulla,01st February 2024.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of land depicted in below names and extents in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2023/540 dated 30.10.2023 prepared by the Survey General situated in the village called Thoddaveli in the Grama Niladhari Division No. MN/62, of Thoddaveli in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follow:

01. Lot zAZ - Thoddavelikaani - Extent : 0.8754 Hectare North: Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known); East : Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known) and Lot C; South: Lots C and B; West: Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known).

02. Lot zBZ - Thoddavelikaani - Extent : 0.2848 Hectare North: Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known) and Lot A; East : Lots A and C; South: Lot C and Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known); West: Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known).

03. Lot zCZ - Thoddavelikaani - Extent : 0.5955 Hectare North: Lots B, A and Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known); East : Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known); South: Road and Lot D (Road); West: Road, Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known) and Lot B.

04. Lot zDZ - Thoddavelikaani - Extent : 0.1869 Hectare North: Lot C; East : Lot C, Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known) and Road; South: Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known) and Lot E; West: Lot E, Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known) and Road.

05. Lot zEZ - Thoddavelikaani - Extent : 0.1726 Hectare North: Road and Lot D(Road); East : Lot D(Road), Road and Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known); South: Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known); West: Thoddavelikaani (claimant not known).
